method: Three existing Ohio facilities matched to retained Geofabrik United States golf geometry through 2026-10-11T20:21:06Z. Shapely 2.1.2 unions the selected areas and computes PointOnSurface, strictly inside after eight-decimal rounding. Original locations were null. No entrance, arrival or public-access inference from geometry.
hash_basis: New sorted_compact_geojson_sha256 hashes use json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')). Upstream geometry_sha256 values are preserved with unspecified original serialization; the complete retained input SHA-256 is independently verified against committed provenance.
